results.note: Validator at ingest/registry.py:164-173 rejects entries with no declaration or with both. Tests at lines 109 and 119 cover both cases, and test_every_shipped_entry_declares_exactly_one_frozen_detection_contract (line 296) checks every shipped entry.

Validator at ingest/registry.py:175-194 requires every TA-Lib entry to set exactly one of derives_from or frozen_propagation_unavailable. The neither case is tested at line 132 and the both case at line 160.
IndicatorRegistry.validate_derived_roots (ingest/registry.py:231-244) rejects a derives_from that points to itself or to an unknown key. The test at line 190 asserts both error messages.
The fields frozen_after_observations, expected_constant, derives_from, frozen_propagation_unavailable and freshness_unmeasurable are declared on IndicatorDefinition at lines 126-130.

The shipped registry.yaml has real values filled in (thresholds, expected_constant for funding rates, derives_from, unavailability reasons). Tests at lines 296, 306, 318 and 332 load the real registry and assert on those values.
All BTC TA-Lib entries derive from the real registered btc_daily_close, and none of them sets frozen_propagation_unavailable.
ETH/SOL/BNB TA-Lib entries leave derives_from unset and carry an exact documented reason. The fabricated eth/sol/bnb_daily_close rows were removed.

No test checks this directly. The only guard is a total row count (== 81) plus per-asset TA-Lib counts in test_assets.py. Nothing compares the registry's keys or each row's definable_for against a baseline, so a changed definable_for, or an added row offset by a removed one, would pass. This diff itself removes three rows relative to its base commit and rewrites the hard-coded counts from 84 to 81 across several test files. It also touches ingest/pipeline.py, which is outside the declared files.
stablecoin_supply and sol_staking carry freshness_unmeasurable reasons naming the fetch wall clock, and the test asserts on both.

The diff removes the frozen-detection and derives_from checks from assert_registry_coverage (registry.py:382-408 now checks only corroboration, golden, required_bars, response_model and parameters). tests/test_coverage.py has no case where a missing frozen or propagation declaration fails the coverage gate; its model_construct fixtures skip the validators entirely. Enforcement exists only at load time via pydantic validators, not in the coverage gate.

note: Schema validators and registry data are real, and the tests make meaningful assertions. However, C8's regression check is only a total row count, not a direct per-key or definable_for comparison, and the diff weakened the coverage gate (C10) by removing its frozen and derives_from checks. The diff also churns many test files (84→81 count edits, reordered fields) and touches ingest/pipeline.py, which is outside the declared files.
